title: UI perf: Windows RTX 4090 smoothness v1
problem: Keep Windows RTX 4090 UI smoothness as a sustainable performance contract: daily smoke, resize, and editor-resize gates must stay explainable and reversible, while the broad ui-gallery-steady surface is treated as maintenance/evidence-only until it is narrowed into smaller steady-contract groups.

repro.summary: Use the broad ui-gallery-steady maintenance run for tail evidence, then validate the resize, editor-resize, code-editor paint-tail, and split overlay single-script contracts with their dedicated gates.

continue_policy.notes: Keep the lane active for Windows smoothness maintenance. Do not re-promote broad ui-gallery-steady from the evidence-only maintenance boundary until the membership is narrowed into smaller steady-contract groups. ui-gallery-context-menu-right-click-steady, ui-gallery-dialog-escape-focus-restore-steady, ui-gallery-dropdown-open-select-steady, ui-gallery-code-editor-torture-autoscroll-steady, ui-gallery-overlay-pointer-move-steady, and ui-gallery-overlay-torture-steady now each have checked-in baselines; keep ui-gallery-overlay-steady evidence-only because the broad suite still mixes overlay, modal, and inspector members. The normalized ui-gallery-complex-steady run with --prelude-each-run now serves as the current paint exemplar, while the no-prelude underflow remains normalization-noise evidence only.
